answer: A rotating beacon broadcasts epoch challenges that only staked agents can answer, and answers are scored against historical reputation stored in the oasis registry. Each agent must stake a unique pigment token minted from a verified hardware root, making duplicate identities costly to forge. Cloning an identity requires re-earning that reputation from zero while forfeiting the original stake, so sybil farming costs more than honest participation. In practice, Agent0102 sees clones fail at the grading gate.
